card.name: "Required" after patients in adverse-event results
card.fires_on: The verb "required" right after a count or phrase like "some patients" or "% of patients", when describing what treatment those patients needed. Weaker on a few other words in similar label text.

modes.label: Patients required treatment
modes.description: The word "required" follows a patient group and introduces an intervention such as hospitalization, dose changes or added therapy.
modes.example: Some patients<< required>> hospitalization and renal replacement therapy.

modes.label: Other label wording
modes.description: Occasional hits on other words in label sentences, such as "conditions" in a use-limitation line.
modes.example: THE USE OF FLUDROCORTISONE ACETATE IN THE TREATMENT OF<< CONDITIONS>> OTHER THAN THOSE INDICATED HERE
